p.i: stant, consilia publica moderantur, & emissarii sedis Antichristiana facti horrendas tristium tragœdia-rum faces accendunt, quibus miseram Europam, nē[?] Deus avertat, brevi in cineres versam lugebunt po-steri.

main_text.p: Characteribus autem seu notulis nostris ex Pro-phetarum, Apostolorum, Apostolicorumq; viro-rum laboribus collectis, interpretationes non adiun-ximus; tum quòd per se facile percipiantur ista notulæ, tum ut iudicium tuum acueremus, ut de noui ipsius sodalitii ingenio & instituto acrius cogitares. Horrenda enim monstra sub pellibus Iesuiticis latuisse præsens dies ostendit, & infinita alia adhuc latere quis, nisi prorsus stupidus, negare audeat? Prior vero Centuria quæ de Pseudoprophetis sancti Prophetæ, Christus & Apostoli tradunt, Iesuitico gregi apprimè convenientia continet. Tu opellam nostram precibus ad Deum tibi utilem redde, expete pacem Ierosolymorum: dic, Tranquilli sint amantes tui.
Sit pax in præmunitione tua & tranquil-litas in palatiis tuis, &c.

page.notes: The mark before "Apostolorum" and "Apostolicorumq;" is a printed ornament or sign, not transcribed. The word "nē" before "Deus" is doubtful (the scan shows a small e-like mark). "cogitares" may carry a stray printed mark after it. The chapter opening "C H A" is cut off at the edge of the scan, so the rest of the heading cannot be read. The ornaments and fleurons below the text are not transcribed. No catchword or signature is visible.
